name: UPS
caption: A submission specialist who had already held all three EIWF titles at one time, and who won the TNM World Title Tournament EIWF hosted in December 1997.
notes: Billed as having lost the EIWF North American Title the night before the tournament's quarterfinals; the reign that preceded that loss is outside this collection's own holdings.

name: Blueline Basher Lund
caption: A hard-hitting entrant who ran the TNM World Title Tournament bracket to the final before losing to UPS.

name: The Demolitionist
caption: A destructive entrant, managed by The Lovely Leah, who battered his way to the tournament's quarterfinals before being disqualified against Kevin Kirker.

name: Ghost
caption: An entrant managed by Snowy who upset the reigning EIWF champion's conqueror en route to the tournament's quarterfinals.

identity.note: The same billing exists in other wings; this entity was minted from its own federation's 1997 documents with no receipt joining it to those — held distinct under the no-auto-merge-and-no-silent-distinctness rule; reopenable on a shared-handler or cross-fed receipt.

name: Firecracker
caption: The reigning EIWF Champion at the time of the tournament, upset in his own opening-round match by Greg Kam.
notes: Billed as EIWF Champion going into the tournament; the title itself was not on the line in this non-title match, and no separate EIWF Championship reign is dated closely enough in this collection's own holdings to register as its own reigns.json row.

name: Greg Kam
caption: An entrant managed by his own version of Sunny who upset EIWF Champion Firecracker before losing to Ghost in the second round.

name: The Hawaiian Crippler
caption: A visiting entrant who won his tournament opener before being battered out by The Demolitionist in the second round.

name: Zanathar
caption: A visiting entrant, managed by Violet, eliminated in the tournament's opening round.

name: Deese Truxion
caption: A visiting entrant, managed by Violet, eliminated in the tournament's opening round.

name: Hartbraker
caption: A former EIWF champion who won his tournament opener by disqualification before losing an upset to Kevin Kirker in the second round.
notes: Billed as a former EIWF champion; no dated reign survives in this collection's own holdings to register separately.

name: Kevin Savage
caption: A former EIWF champion managed by Tara, disqualified in the tournament's opening round for a brass-knuckles shot.

name: Kevin Kirker
caption: An entrant who won two brass-knuckles-assisted matches before being disqualified himself against The Demolitionist in the quarterfinals.

name: "Double A" Arn Austin
caption: An entrant eliminated in the tournament's opening round by Kevin Kirker's brass knuckles.

name: Onslaught
caption: An entrant eliminated in the tournament's opening round by UPS.

name: Hell's Knight

name: Rhett Smith
caption: A tag-ranks regular who advanced two rounds, beating his own tag partner Top Dawg along the way, before losing to UPS in the quarterfinals.

name: The Terminator

name: Frapp Assassin #1

name: "The Jiggster" Jimmy Jazz

name: "Darkside" Tim Johns
caption: A self-declared undefeated TNM World Champion who disputed the December 1997 tournament's legitimacy and formed the Revolutions Raiders the night of its final.
notes: A rival claimant, never resolved against the tournament's own eventual winner (UPS) within this collection's own holdings; his own prior title claim is gap-registered, not adjudicated.

name: "Big Daddy Cool" Justin Donovan
caption: Tim Johns' tag partner in the Revolutions Raiders, unveiled the night of the tournament final.
